definitions.explanation: The act of using one thing in place of another. Refers to both the process of substituting and the substitute itself.

examples.japanese: {代替|だいたい}⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{代替|だいたい}⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since the trains stopped, substitute buses were operated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{化石|かせき}{燃料|ねんりょう}→化石燃料：19083_kasekinenryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギー→再生可能エネルギー：08751_saiseikanouenerugii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{代替|だいたい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The movement to replace fossil fuels with renewable energy is advancing.

notes:
The traditional reading is だいたい, but the reading だい⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧え has become common in spoken Japanese. Both are accepted, though だいたい remains standard in formal and written contexts. Not to be confused with the adverb {大体|だいたい} (roughly, approximately), which is a different word entirely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代替|だいたい}⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (alternative plan)
- {代替|だいたい}⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧ (alternative means)
- {代替|だいたい}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (substitute product)
- {代替|だいたい}⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧ (alternative energy)
- {代替|だいたい}⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ (substitute transportation)
